items.label: 2 Packages
items.value: The Sectional Sofa is shipped in 2 packages, so they may be arrived separately in different time. Please be patient. And cushions are vacuum-packed, it will take 48 hours to return to its original shape.

items.label: Comfortable Couch
items.value: Made of breathable skin-friendly fabric, offers a soft and natural touch when sitting or lying on this sofa. Linen Fabric does not pill and ensure long-term use.

items.label: Sturdy Construction
items.value: The sleeper sofa is equipped with solid wood frame to ensure sturdiness and durability. Featured with 650lbs weight capacity.

items.label: Soft Cushion
items.value: High-density sponge provides you with a comfortable and soft sitting experience. And the seat and back cushion covers are removable and washable.

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: You can easily assemble the couch following the instruction provided. This sofa couch can be assemble within 20 minutes.
